newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady on Tuesday amid quiet activity following the U.S. Memorial Day weekend.
"People are regrouping from the long weekend," a dealer said. "Everybody is trying to figure out if they are long or short or where they are supposed to be. I think trading has been nil."
This market was thin before the holidays, he added.
One St Louis dealer agreed, noting the focus was on logistical problems and where trucks were located.
Demand has been steady. But the best demand was probably from the merchants who are covering their sales. Also, buyers were eyeing the substitutes, such as soyhulls, a North Carolina dealer said.
In Minneapolis, a broker said there was nearby interest for an extra truck or two.
"Everybody has stuff to sell for next week but nobody has anything for this week," he said.
